name: Bailey et al. EV Nudge RCT
description: Randomized controlled field experiment on EV charging price incentives vs moral suasion across 217 vehicles. Provided empirical evidence that financial incentives shift ~49% of peak charging while pro-social nudges have near-zero uplift.
usage_in_gridnudge: Simulator behavior priors and LinTS synthetic ground-truth uplift benchmarking.

name: ACN-Data (Caltech / JPL)
description: Public dataset of 30,000+ workplace charging sessions logging arrival time, dwell duration, kWh delivered, and charging power curves.
usage_in_gridnudge: Plug-in time distributions, charging power profiles, and session duration distributions.

name: Vehicle Energy Dataset (VED & eVED)
description: Real-world vehicle trajectory dataset with GPS, speed, elevation, and battery power logs for passenger EVs in diverse weather.
usage_in_gridnudge: Trip energy consumption calibration and Monte Carlo journey confidence model validation.

name: Oxford & NASA PCoE Battery Lab Sets
description: Comprehensive lithium-ion cell cycle aging datasets under varying C-rates, temperatures, and depth-of-discharge (DoD).
license_access: NASA Ames & Oxford University Open Datasets
usage_in_gridnudge: Semi-empirical battery stress scoring and relative cycle-life delta ranges.

name: Ministry of Power India Public EV Hubs
description: Official dataset of operational public EV charging stations across Delhi NCR, including lat/lon, connector types, and rated kW.
usage_in_gridnudge: Geographic placement, connector counts, and fast DC charging power ratings for Delhi stations.

name: Delhi Hourly Grid Load & Weather (2018–2025)
description: Multi-year hourly substation load and concurrent ambient temperature records for the National Capital Territory of Delhi.
usage_in_gridnudge: Non-EV base load duck curves, evening residential AC peak modeling, and heatwave multipliers.
